ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic phrases? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic phrases has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic phrases with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic phrases.
   D. Use Islamic phrases to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Environment School cleanliness? (1 mark)
   A. Use Environment School cleanliness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment School cleanliness.
   C. Say Environment School cleanliness has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Environment School cleanliness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic etiquettes? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
   B. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic etiquettes has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic etiquettes with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.
   B. Say Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on: has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Love for parents? (1 mark)
   A. Say Love for parents has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Love for parents to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Love for parents with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Love for parents.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Birth of Prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Birth of Prophet.
   B. Say Birth of Prophet has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Birth of Prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Birth of Prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

13. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN.
   B. Apply the teaching of Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Arabic Alphabet 1.0 QUR’AN has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Pillars of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic etiquettes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic phrases and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Love for parents and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
